title: Prevent Fibonacci and HA extension-line ghost growth during continuous viewport panning
changes: Put drawing geometry inside a stationary plot clip with an independently translated inner layer; no growing strokes or shapes beyond the plot during drag.
Keep Fibonacci level captions aligned with the plot right edge and drawn rays buffered under a fixed plot clip, avoiding redraw-induced extension jumps.
Keep the selected daily HA extension line/dot clipped inside the plot, while its price badge moves vertically on a separate fixed-X price-axis layer.
Separate drawing price tags for rectangles and long/short positions into a fixed-X, clipped price-axis layer; preserve true price/time anchors and click interactions.
Anchor Fibonacci 0 dot to its original timestamp rather than clamping to the viewport edge; no edge respawn.
Preserve v2.1.22 floating pan, Pionex WebSocket, CoinGlass 7D, BB/HA/CCI/S-State/RR, drawing JSON and four-window state.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite six files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar. Do not update Cloudflare Worker/R2.
validationNote: Chromium synthetic-gesture regression tests passed for clip geometry, axis-anchored labels, stable HA price, 1D and 4H. Production TradingView recording replay and real live-session QA remain untested.
